Implementation evidence

What exists—and what doesn’t.

IMPLEMENTED / V0.2

  • YOLO11 nano inference and ByteTrack tracking
  • Webcam and uploaded-video processing
  • Zone entry rules and CSV event export
  • Streamlit dashboard and SQLite history
  • Validated mission proposals via Ollama or OpenAI
  • Seven backend tests; re-run successfully for this build

NOT IMPLEMENTED

  • Flight control or drone command output
  • Geographic navigation or obstacle avoidance
  • Depth estimation or trajectory prediction
  • Swarm / multi-agent coordination
  • Drone-specific detection model
  • Validated frame rate or field performance

Engineering decisions

Safety before spectacle.

01Human authority over AI recommendations ＋

The technical dossier states that operator authority supersedes AI-generated recommendations. The v0.2 assistant only proposes supported mission settings; the user must review and apply them.

02Explicit input and output contracts ＋

The prototype limits mission proposals to recognized classes, normalized image zones, and bounded confidence thresholds. Invalid or reversed bounds are rejected.

03Validate before claiming performance ＋

The 5-/10-inch dossier makes endurance, detection quality, latency, telemetry reliability, and flight safety acceptance items. No numerical performance is published before controlled testing.

Research layer

PPO / DQN in CybORG

The graduation research models defense as a Markov Decision Process: observe an eight-feature state, select among eight defensive actions, and learn from reward feedback in a simulated 10-host, three-subnet environment.

Research design · evaluation targets are not results

Application layer

Identity + operations

The current repository implements role-based Admin, SOC, and Research workspaces with secure sessions, scoped resources, incident response workflows, experiment records, and demo simulation views.

01

Contribution

Lead author across the research lifecycle.

Mohammed led research, system design, experimentation, integration, testing, and documentation, as recorded in the current CV.

02

Verified implementation

Security controls are part of the product model.

Opaque HttpOnly sessions, CSRF and origin checks, role and environment scopes, approval-gated high-risk responses, reauthorization for background jobs, WebSocket scope intersection, and a hash-chained audit log are documented and implemented in the repository.

03

Limits

The repository is explicit about unfinished edges.

Several navigation areas are guarded stubs; telemetry panels remain empty until collectors are connected; rate limiting is per-process; and production migrations require Alembic. The simulation route serves demo fixtures, not measured PPO/DQN performance.
